name: repoplugin-planning
description: Evidence-led planning and reviewed plan-pack generation for repository changes.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a repository change into a reviewed plan pack.
interface.longDescription: Establishes the task baseline, gathers evidence, interviews for material unknowns, reviews drafts, and creates an implementation-ready plan pack.
interface.defaultPrompt: Plan this repository change through research, open questions, review, and a final plan pack.
